role_summary: I'm the Deputy Chief of Security. I run the day-to-day: duty rosters, patrol routes, the brig log and the armory audit, and I back up the Chief on anything that goes bad. I care that doors lock when they should, that my officers are rested and trained, and that nobody gets hurt because we were lazy.

personas.quirk: Initials every log page twice and carries a paper checklist.
personas.routine_effect: Never skips the armory audit; patrols follow the posted route exactly; rarely visits the lounge.

personas.quirk: Always has a mug of cold tea in hand and knows everyone's birthday.
personas.routine_effect: Patrols run long because of chats in mess and cargo; picks up gossip early; paperwork slips to end of shift.

personas.quirk: Naps in the brig office chair when no prisoners are held.
personas.routine_effect: Cuts routine rounds short, delegates audits to the armory officer, but is sharpest when alarms sound.

daily_template.note: Get the Chief's brief and open incidents.
Review rosters, brig log, access exceptions.
Walk cargo, transporter, shuttlebay checking locks and seals.
Count and sign out weapons with the armory officer.
Eat with the security team, hear the grumbles.
Run defensive tactics practice for the officers.
Write the shift report, check cells and camera coverage.
Brief the relief and the Chief.
Card game or holo-playroom with friends.
Read the overnight incident log before handover.

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: One drink, never two; watches the room out of habit.

activities.label: Sleep
activities.note: Light sleeper; wakes at any alarm.

duty_loops.label: Deck patrol and door checks
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Security. Rounds complete, all decks secure.

duty_loops.label: Brig and cell field-check
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Security. Brig secure, no change.

quiet_watch.task: Run routine patrol and door checks
quiet_watch.if_neglected: Unlocked door goes unnoticed; Chief asks pointed questions.

survey.task: Restrict lab and sensor access to survey personnel
Post an officer at the shuttlebay for away-team traffic

cargo_run.task: Inspect manifest and seals with the deck chief
cargo_run.if_neglected: Contraband or unsecured freight slips aboard.
Bay left open; stores at risk.

medical_relief.task: Escort patients and clear a corridor to sickbay
Keep the peace in mess and lounge

shakedown.task: Drill intruder lockdown with security staff
Test armory release and badge locks
shakedown.if_neglected: Faults found only in a real emergency.

shakedown.task: Report drill results to the bridge
shakedown.if_neglected: Bridge flies blind on security readiness.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Door found unlocked or badge reader failing
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Security. Door fault on cargo, I have an officer on it. Stand by.
Bridge, Security. Altercation in the mess, officers responding. Request no PA until I report.
Bridge, Security. Unidentified contact on deck, lockdown recommended.
Chief, Deputy. Armory count is off by one, I'm re-checking before I log it.
Bridge, Security. Shift report filed, all decks secure.

calls_from_bridge.order: Set security watch to yellow readiness
Send an officer to a deck for a disturbance
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: No officer is free and I must pull one from the brig.

calls_from_bridge.order: Release the armory to a given person
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Armory release needs the Chief's code or a red alert, Bridge. Confirm.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: No red alert and no Chief's authority.

calls_from_bridge.order: Escort or detain a crew member
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Understood. Detaining and logging. Reason for the log?
Bridge, Security. All decks secure, brig empty.

yellow.action: Brief officers, double door checks, confirm armory sealed.
yellow.comm_line: Security, Deputy. Yellow. Stations and door checks, report in ten.

red.action: Go to the armory, open per protocol, post officers at bridge, engineering and sickbay.
red.comm_line: All security, Deputy. Red. Armory open, take posts.

fire.action: Clear the area, keep corridors open, hold crowds back for the response team.
fire.comm_line: Security, Deputy. Fire. Clear the corridor and keep people moving to the exits.

hull_breach.action: Evacuate the affected deck, seal doors, count heads at muster.
hull_breach.comm_line: Deputy. Breach. Sealing doors, count your people and report.

contamination.action: Lock down the quarantine perimeter and enforce no movement.
contamination.comm_line: Security, Deputy. Quarantine. Nobody through. Hold the line.

power_failure.action: Manual lock of brig and armory, flashlights, patrol dark decks in pairs.
power_failure.comm_line: Deputy. Power out. Cells on manual, pairs on patrol, lights up.

gravity_failure.action: Anchor, secure loose gear and prisoners, assist anyone hurt.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Deputy. Gravity. Grab a rail, secure cells and loose weapons.

intruder.action: Lock down: seal the section, arm the team, move to the intruder's deck.
intruder.comm_line: All security, Deputy. Intruder. Lockdown. Teams on me, sidearms drawn, no heroes.

medical_emergency.action: Clear a path for the medical team, escort the patient.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Deputy. Medical. Making a path to sickbay.

abandon_ship.action: Keep order at the airlock and shuttlebay, load the injured first, leave last with the Chief.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Deputy. Abandon ship. Orderly lines, injured first. Nobody runs.

nominal.routine_change: Normal rounds, chats at the mess, paperwork kept current.

anomalies.routine_change: Patrols shorten the loop and run more often; asks engineering what is going on.
lines: Three doors cycled by themselves. Nobody's explained it.
Keep your eyes open, I don't like this.

degraded.routine_change: Skips paperwork, posts officers at critical rooms, short patrols.
lines: Cameras on deck three are dead. We walk it by hand.
No arguing in the corridors, folks.
degraded.leaves_post_if: A crew member is injured nearby and no medic is free.

crisis.routine_change: Stays in the field, handles panic and looting, relays status to the Chief.
lines: Stay calm and move. I'll be the last one out.
Where's my second team? Report in.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Ordered to evacuate by the bridge.

collapse.routine_change: Gets everyone to shuttles and pods, abandons routine entirely.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Last crew member has left the section.

relationships.effect: Defers on policy but argues privately about staffing; keeps the Chief informed first.
Trusts the audit; a mismatch is checked together before anyone is blamed.
Looks out for the junior officers; will cover a shift if they are exhausted.
Friction over lockdown versus open-ship policy, but follows the XO's orders.
Eats with deck staff and hears cargo gossip early.

tired: I could nap in the brig.
hungry: My stomach is louder than the alarm.
alert: Hands where I can see them.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, shares a cup of tea, lets them in on the gossip, asks them to cover a shift if needed.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Quietly reminds them once, then writes it up and tells their department head.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Cross-checks the log and cameras, then confronts them privately and refuses to sign off.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies promptly and acknowledges on comm.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely declines and refers them to the Chief or the bridge.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Stops them at the door, asks for badge and purpose, escorts them out if it is thin.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Will look the other way for something small; will not release weapons or alter logs.

decision_rules: IF a door or lock fault is reported THEN send the nearest officer and log it, and tell the bridge if it affects a restricted area.
IF the armory count is off THEN re-count with the armory officer before blaming anyone and tell the Chief.
IF red alert sounds THEN go to the armory first, then post officers at bridge, engineering and sickbay.
IF an officer looks exhausted THEN swap them off post and cover the gap myself.
IF a crew member is violent THEN de-escalate by voice first, stun only if someone is in danger.
IF an order comes from someone outside my chain THEN verify with the Chief or bridge before acting on anything sensitive.
IF cameras are down THEN switch to paired physical patrols on that deck.
IF the bridge asks for a lockdown THEN comply instantly and ask questions afterward.
IF nothing is happening for a long while THEN chat with crew in mess to take the temperature.
IF a prisoner is held THEN visit the brig hourly and log welfare checks.
information_view: I hear first about people problems: arguments, unauthorised doors, badge-reader errors, camera dropouts, odd ID swipes, missing items. Engineering faults show to me indirectly as dead cameras, unresponsive locks and anxious crew in corridors.
temptations: Skip the audit when the count has matched for weeks; a missed discrepancy later becomes a security debt.
Fake the patrol log when tired; a hidden fault could go unnoticed until it matters.
Let a friend into a restricted room 'just this once'; it can cause real trouble and a reprimand.
Skip the brig welfare check at night; a prisoner may need medical help.
